changes.comment: Add an adaptive coverflow carousel variant with container-fitted previews, accessible selection, and separate navigation areas; use fully rounded carousel navigation buttons. Add ore-speed-reading with stable focal positioning, punctuation-aware pacing, context highlighting, sentence navigation, explicit overflow recovery, responsive icon-only transport, and touch-accessible pace and keyboard help. Keep popovers and tooltips within the viewport when neither side of the trigger fits. Add 1.5× speech playback and consistent numeric speed labels. Preserve select keyboard navigation beneath a stationary pointer.
